name: Abnormal
source:
Stephanie's a cute but ostracized and bullied high school tomboy with a determined will to be her own person. At the cusp of graduation, she must face her bully once again, and question who she is and who she wants to be. Accompany Stephanie as she navigates her relationships with friends, family, and enemies amidst burgeoning desires and identity crises as she enters a new phase in life.

[From F95Zone]
